title: Fellowship - Sports Event Pickleball
summary: Rotary Club of Mumbai West End organised a fun-filled sports fellowship session featuring Pickleball.
description: Rotary Club of Mumbai West End organised a fun-filled sports fellowship session featuring Pickleball. Members enthusiastically participated in the game, enjoying friendly matches while promoting fitness, sportsmanship and camaraderie. The session provided a wonderful opportunity for members to bond and enjoy an active morning together.
